prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide photographic banner for an inclusive educational game library. Primary request: realistic educational play materials on a light wooden classroom table: a small collection of square picture matching cards showing everyday fruit and school objects, a simple blue rubber ball, a red book and a plain green school backpack standing softly out of focus in the background. Style: thoughtful editorial classroom photography, warm natural side daylight, realistic paper, wood and fabric textures. Composition: landscape 16:9, tabletop seen at a gentle overhead angle, all important materials arranged toward the center-right, uncluttered warm ivory background with calm space on the left. Mood: welcoming, tactile, calm and easy to understand. Constraints: no people, no hands, no text or labels on cards, no lettering on book or backpack, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no icons, no confetti, no busy classroom decorations.
